items.title: Starbucks raises full-year outlook as CEO tells CNBC the chain is winning back customer loyalty
items.description: Starbucks posted its fourth straight quarter of same-store sales growth, as it continues a turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.

items.title: Star AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner is unwinding trades after steep losses, sources say
items.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund is unwinding trades and may be forced to liquidate assets, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: U.S. economy slowed to 1.5% growth rate in Q2; June core inflation at 3.3%
items.description: While the GDP number was below expectations, the miss appeared to come from a decline in federal government spending and inventories.

items.title: Cyclospora outbreak has hurt Taco Bell but sales are already improving, Yum Brands CEO says
items.description: The restaurant company provided no update on the cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell restaurants is affecting its business.

items.title: Egypt says drone hit two ships at Mediterranean port as attacks on energy infrastructure widen
items.description: The unclaimed attack comes as Iran, its Houthi alllies in Yemen and Iraqi militias have widened strikes on energy infrastructure across the region.

items.title: Ferrari raises 2026 guidance after Q2 earnings beat
items.description: Ferrari is bumping up its 2026 guidance after beating Wall Street's second quarter expectations amid "healthy" demand for its products.

items.title: Rolls-Royce CEO says major hyperscaler nuclear deal is imminent as data center demand soars
items.description: Rolls-Royce is riding two of the biggest investment themes in global markets: the defense boom and the AI buildout.

items.title: Iran says it will 'punish the aggressor today' after 'heavy wave' of U.S. strikes
items.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard threatened further escalation on Thursday after a wave of retaliatory U.S. strikes on the country overnight.

items.title: Bank of England holds UK interest rate steady at 3.75% — but policymakers see upside inflation risk
items.description: The Bank of England on Thursday held U.K. interest rates steady at 3.75%, in line with economists' expectations.

items.title: Wealth managers face a new challenger: their clients’ AI chatbots
items.description: Large language models may give financial advisors a run for their money, but wealth management leaders say the human touch can't be replaced.

items.title: Loeffler's financial disclosure reveals husband’s ties to exclusive Trump Jr.-backed private club
items.description: The Executive Branch club, where members include Trump administration officials, investors and business leaders, charges a $500,000 entry fee.

items.title: Meta tanks nearly 9%, Microsoft jumps 9% as the AI trade splits Big Tech

items.title: Samsung says chip crunch will last until 2028 as quarterly profit soars
items.description: Samsung Electronics extended its record run with second-quarter operating profit topping analysts' estimates.

items.description: Attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea and Black Sea are pushing shipowners to reroute cargo and rethink global trade risks.

items.title: Shell posts best quarterly profit in four years as Iran war boosts oil and gas prices

items.description: Auto giant Stellantis on Thursday swung to profit in the second quarter, boosted by rising demand in North America.

items.description: Record heatwaves are straining Western Europe’s infrastructure, businesses and budgets as wildfires and insurance costs rise.

items.title: Senate Judiciary postpones Blanche AG nomination vote over Trump-IRS settlement concerns

items.description: China's Commerce Ministry said Thursday the U.S. Federal Communications Commission has repeatedly ignored Beijing's restrained stance.
